name: studio-storefront
description: Talk to the OpsAgents Studio Shopify storefront — search the catalog, manage carts, and answer policy questions for studio.opsagents.agency. Wraps the live Shopify Storefront MCP at studio.opsagents.agency/api/mcp.
author: MSApps (https://msapps.mobi)

pillars.supervised: All write actions (cart updates) require explicit user intent. The Storefront MCP itself is unauthenticated/public, so there is no admin surface here — it's the same data and capabilities a regular shopper has.
pillars.orchestrated: SKILL.md mandates search-before-cart, surface_url-after-search, and never-pretend-checkout-completed.
pillars.secured: No credentials. Public Shopify Storefront MCP endpoint. Single egress to studio.opsagents.agency only.
pillars.agents: R=studio-storefront, T=storefront-mcp (5 tools), M=none (stateless), P=search → inspect → optionally cart → surface checkout URL
